seo.title: Social Impact | Na Level Empire Media
seo.description: How Na Level Empire Media trains and hires from underrepresented Toronto communities, reinvests 25% of profits and works toward B Corp certification.

cards.title: Skills That Last a Lifetime
cards.text: Every production is a classroom. Our apprentice-based model trains youth in camera operation, sound engineering, lighting, editing, and live streaming — skills that translate directly into sustainable careers in Toronto's $2B+ media industry.

cards.title: Who We Hire First
cards.text: We actively recruit from Toronto's underrepresented communities: newcomers and refugees, Indigenous youth, individuals with disabilities, and young people from low-income backgrounds. Our workforce reflects the city we serve.

cards.title: 25% Profit Reinvestment
cards.text: A minimum of 25% of net profits is reinvested into our training programs, mental health support, equipment access for employees, and community partnerships — a commitment written into our corporate governance documents.

cards.title: B Corp Pathway
cards.text: We are on a structured path to B Corp Certification by Year 3 — a globally recognized standard for businesses meeting the highest standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and legal accountability.
